answer_1.quote: We construct a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate role-playing capabilities of LLMs, testing a wide range of models, both closed-source and open-source...
datasets: CharacterBox scenes derived from novels and scripts (10 well‑known novels and scripts, bilingual English/Chinese)
answer_1.outputs: Role‑playing trajectories consisting of character actions, dialogues, and environment updates

answer_2.quote: To comprehensively evaluate the role‑playing capabilities of LLMs in long‑term dynamic environments, we design metrics across three main dimensions... Each metric is scored from 1 to 5... We leverage GPT‑4 to first generate a critique of the character's trajectory, integrating this critique into the prompt before assessing each criterion.
automatic_metrics: GPT‑4 based scoring of seven role‑playing dimensions

answer_3.quote: Given the subjective nature of evaluating behavior trajectories, we further employ GPT‑4 as a reward model to assess role‑playing performance from seven distinct perspectives... We also fine‑tune a smaller reward model (CharacterRM) distilled from GPT‑4.
methods: LLM‑based scoring of role‑playing trajectories using a rubric of seven dimensions

answer_4.quote: We enlist three experts familiar with both the five Chinese and five English scenes used in the assessment to rate the character trajectories. We calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between CharacterBox scores and expert ratings...
answer_4.guideline: Experts rate the quality of character trajectories (no detailed rubric mentioned).
